notes: Two «ح» families. The text writes يحيى, أبو سلمة, زينب بنت أبي سلمة, أم سلمة once, after the second family's «أبي», so they are the shared tail (rule 3).
«أبي» is معاذ's father, a relation the text does not name; not identified. Umm Salama's words are the saying, so she is the last link. «- واللفظ له -» is left out.
